text:
Maria: quick async check — need cross-stack ownership + launch gates for QueryRouter (customer P0). can product/runtime/infra/security confirm blockers and minimal acceptance criteria? :eyes:

Kevin: sketched a rollout plan earlier: canary on dedicated pool -> monitor latency/error budgets -> ramp to reserved capacity -> GA. need runtime to confirm KV cache warmup and cold-start behavior.

Sophie: infra heads-up — QueryRouter will need a static egress range and 2x reserved GPU nodes for the expected initial traffic. net changes + quota request = ~10 business days. filed INF-1012.

Andre: security checklist: SAML + KMS envelope support + E2E audit logs. I need a test tenant and threat-model signoff before any customer-facing canary. SEC-420 created, ETA ~4 business days.

Dave: ops/runbook draft items (short):
```
- rollback triggers:
  - p95 latency > 220ms for 5m
  - error rate > 3% for 3m
  - KV cache miss rate > 2x baseline for 5m
- automated phase-down to smaller pool + route to fallback model
```
Need these encoded in automation.

Maria: two product decisions: 1) is prefix/KV prewarm required for GA? 2) can we do a soft-launch to a subset of customers while infra finishes quotas?

Kevin: runtime tradeoff — if infra can't reserve capacity we can ship without prefix caching but with smaller context window + stricter rate limits. lower latency risk but higher token cost. I'll add a compat flag to the manifest to opt out of prewarm. ETA for KV warmup tests: RT-270 (3 days).

Sophie: soft-launch ok from infra if traffic stays under initial quota and burst capacity remains disabled. we can fast-track quota if PMs lock a firm date. INF-1012 ETA 9-11 business days unless prioritized. :calendar:

Andre: soft-launch acceptable only for customers inside our sandbox org until KMS/SAML validated. no production keys until signoff.

Dave: ops OK with soft-launch provided we have clear A/B routing + one-click kill-switch (route all traffic to fallback). need the route path added to the service manifest.

Kevin: adding canary manifest snippet now. example:
```
route:
  - id: canary
    percent: 10
    model: queryrouter-v1-small
```
I'll add a runtime flag to flip caching.

Maria: owners: Kevin (runtime) for rollout manifest and KV tests, Sophie (infra) for reserve nodes/quota, Andre (security) for KMS/SAML + threat signoff, Dave (prodops) for runbook + automation. I'll drive product decisions and customer comms. please drop blocking tickets & ETAs here.

Kevin: RT-270 (KV warmup tests + manifest) — ETA 3 days. :white_check_mark:

Sophie: INF-1012 (egress + reserved nodes) — ETA 9 business days. escalating with infra lead. :arrow_up:

Andre: SEC-420 (threat model + test tenant provisioning) — ETA 4 business days.

Dave: OPS-34 (runbook + rollback automation + playbook) — ETA 2 business days. will include runbook and automation pr.

Maria: timeline looks like: soft-launch in ~2 weeks if INF-1012 can be expedited, otherwise gated GA in ~4 weeks. i'll sync with sales on messaging and customer gating. thanks everyone. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to canary pool at 2024-08-10T14:00Z (placeholder until CI passes).
